question: When and where is my sister's wedding?
answer: October 3rd at Rosewood Garden in Austin

haystack_sessions.content: Hey! Big news - my sister finally set a date for her wedding. It's going to be on October 3rd at the Rosewood Garden venue in Austin.
That's exciting! Congratulations to your sister. October 3rd at Rosewood Garden in Austin - lovely choice. Are you involved in the preparations?
Yes, I'm giving a toast, which is terrifying. I also need to rent a suit sometime before then.
You'll do great. A toast is an honor. Do you have ideas for what you'll say?
I booked my hotel in Austin for the wedding weekend. Also picked up the suit - navy blue, fits well.
Nice, that's one less thing off your list. Which hotel did you book?
The Hotel Van Zandt. My toast draft is coming along, still needs work though.

question: When did I finish my first pottery class?

haystack_sessions.content: I just signed up for a beginner pottery class. It starts April 15th and runs for six weeks, sessions every Monday and Friday.
That sounds like a fun creative outlet. A six-week course twice a week will get you comfortable on the wheel quickly.
I finished my first pottery class yesterday! Made a lopsided bowl but I'm proud of it.
Congratulations on finishing the course! A first bowl is always a milestone - lopsided or not. What's next, an intermediate class?
Maybe. The instructor said my glazing technique was the strongest part.
Update: I enrolled in the intermediate pottery class. It starts in June.
Great progression! The intermediate class will build on that glazing strength of yours.
I've been getting into trail running this summer. Did 12 kilometers on the Barton Creek greenbelt last weekend.
12K on Barton Creek is solid - that trail has some real elevation. Are you training for a race?
Considering a trail half-marathon in November. Also started composting this month.
The compost bin is working great. First batch of compost should be ready by October.
October compost is perfect timing for fall planting. How's the half-marathon training going?
